propositions: Dedicated executor client must pass max_retries=0 to jira.JIRA constructor and reject any session with nonzero max_retries value.
Each DC summary write invocation must issue exactly one GET (pre-mutation), one PUT (write), and one GET (read-back) without hidden retries or repeats.

Initial GET fault is classified retryable (transient) or permanent (definitive HTTP error); PUT fault is ambiguous and returns commit_unknown without read-back; successful PUT read-back is authoritative only when observed summary equals intended summary.

After ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET observation using shared budget is mapped to recovered (observed equals intended), conclusive old state (observed differs), or non-replaying commit_unknown (GET fails).

Completion log must emit exactly once per DC terminal or exhausted outcome, containing only logical id, disposition, invocation count, request count, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 code points; total serialized log capped at 1,024 code points.
Injected one-attempt/no-sleep policy in _with_connection_retry must preserve legacy wrapper defaults for non-executor callers.
